runtime_policy.time_policy: preserve the designated saved-world time; record world_time_ticks in every export
runtime_policy.camera_policy: preserve the designated saved-world yaw/pitch; no mouse input during warmup or measurement
runtime_policy.input_policy: inject only the benchmark command; BENCH-02 additionally holds W after MEASURING begins

scenarios.name: Stationary render
scenarios.scene_identity: minimal RenyBaseline00 or heavy New World snapshot at the designated start route
scenarios.movement: stationary; no movement or camera input
scenarios.purpose: renderer baseline and static-scene frame-time distribution

scenarios.name: Chunk traversal
scenarios.scene_identity: same designated snapshot and start route as BENCH-01; traversal is the only changing input
scenarios.movement: hold W from the MEASURING transition through completion; sprint disabled
scenarios.movement_speed: Minecraft default walking speed with mouseSensitivity=0.5
scenarios.camera: fixed start yaw/pitch; no mouse input
scenarios.purpose: chunk streaming, generation, lighting, meshing, upload, and I/O

scenarios.name: Industrial base
scenarios.scene_identity: heavy New World industrial/magic snapshot; minimal RenyBaseline00 is an explicitly non-equivalent proxy
scenarios.movement: stationary; no movement or camera input
scenarios.purpose: TileEntity, Forge-event, machine-network, and complex-block pressure

scenarios.name: Shader torture
scenarios.scene_identity: same designated snapshot at a water/foliage/sky-facing route; shader pack identity is hashed in runtime-manifest.json
scenarios.movement: stationary; no movement or camera input
scenarios.shader_policy: only B and D enable the exact Sildur pack; A and C retain OptiFine with shaderPack empty
scenarios.purpose: expensive shader passes and CPU/GPU renderer interaction

run_policy.reset_policy: restore the exact world snapshot and profile files before every run; archive shutdown snapshots separately
run_policy.capture_policy: formal results use the append-only profiler capture; any capture overflow or truncation invalidates the attempt
